name: smronju/nativephp-scanner
description: Implements NativePHP Mobile's Scanner::scan() on both platforms — a full-screen CameraX + ML Kit (bundled model, works without Google Play services) scanner on Android, AVFoundation on iOS — with single and continuous modes. nativephp/mobile core registers Scanner.Scan on neither platform.

bridge_functions.name: Scanner.Scan
bridge_functions.description: Parameters {prompt, continuous, formats, id, event}. Returns at once and opens a full-screen camera scanner; asks for camera permission first when needed. Dispatches CodeScanned {data, format, id} for the first code (single mode, then closes) or for every code (continuous mode, same value ignored while it stays in view and for 1.5 s after). Closing without a code dispatches ScannerCancelled {cancelled, reason, id}; reason is cancelled, done (continuous, at least one code) or permission_denied.

info_plist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scans product barcodes and invoice QR codes.
